items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser suits oily, sensitive-looking skin without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin's comfort and moisture, and the scan shows moisture could be better.
A mineral SPF 50 is the most useful daily step for keeping the look of fine lines from progressing, and it is a gentle choice for fair, sensitive skin.

response.routine_note: I have left out retinol and other retinoid-type products because they are best avoided during pregnancy, so please ask your doctor or midwife before adding any active. Use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, and apply the sunscreen last each morning.
